description: Retrieve recent public LinkedIn posts, commentary, and engagement metrics (likes, comments, reposts) for an executive handle (10 Credits per call, 0 Credits when empty).

page.description: 1-based pagination page number for recent profile activity posts (default: 1).

username.description: LinkedIn person handle (e.g. "satyanadella") or profile URL.

name: b2b_get_person_posts

outputSchema.description: Recent public LinkedIn posts authored by the target person.

items.description: Normalized public LinkedIn activity post record.

author.description: Post author display name or handle.

post_id.description: Unique LinkedIn activity or post identifier.

posted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp or relative publication date.

url.description: Permalink URL to the public LinkedIn post.

freshness.description: Data freshness metadata indicating cache status and upstream capture timestamp.

age_seconds.description: Age of the returned snapshot in seconds.

cached.description: True when served from warm cache; false on live upstream fetch.

source_fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when upstream data was captured.

meta.description: Request execution telemetry, credit cost, and cache metadata.

cache_hit.description: Whether the record was served from hot PostgreSQL/Redis cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 404/empty/error).
